text: A repository whose root package.json exists only to pin tooling (commitlint, husky, markdownlint) matches the node row and receives typescript-conventions.md scoped to **/*.ts and **/*.tsx, which can never load there. The formatter stands down and the grants are inert, so the cost is one dead artifact rather than wrong behaviour, and the retirement sweep reaches the right verdict on it later. Separating a tooling-only manifest from an application one has no manifest-level signal, and the fingerprint reads manifests rather than walking sources on purpose.
